source_text: Public health policy integrates voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) as a strategy to curb HIV transmission, following WHO-endorsed randomized controlled trials (e.g., ANRS 1265 Trial, 2005) showing a 60% reduction in heterosexual acquisition risk among heterosexual men. [178]
